page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 20. Main text in one column at right. Left margin holds one marginal note beside the Latin paragraph beginning "Quem Scriptura" (two lines, "Maior Propositio Apodeixis." in a small italic block). Heading "Apodeixis." centred above that paragraph.

main_text.p: Ex superioribus locis colligitur; Christū posteaquam sese pro nobis hostiam obtulit Deo, sedere ad dextram Patris: non vt seipsū rursus offerat, sed vt prorsus eos seruet qui per ipsum accedunt ad Deum, perpetuum habens sacerdotium, & semper viuens vt interpellet pro eis: & vnici sacrificij semel in cruce peracti, ac nunquam iterandi perpetua, perfectaque virtute & efficacia, eos plenissimè Deo reconciliet, qui vera fide summum hoc beneficium recipiunt.
His igitur omnibus aggregatis, nostram ἀπόδειξιν conficiamus in hunc modum.
main_text.head: Ἀπόδειξις.

p.i: Quem Scriptura dicit fuisse veteris Testamenti sacerdotibus sacrificiisq;, adumbratum, & nouissimis temporibus, (Veteris Testamenti sacerdotio sublato & caeremoniis abrogatis) noui Testamenti Mediatorem & Pontificem exhibitu: seipsum semel in cruce obtulisse & tradidisse pro nobis oblationem & victimam Deo: & factum esse sacerdotem simul & victimam, vt peccata nostra tolleret, & vnica illa oblatione eos qui sanctificantur in perpetuum consecraret: eaque hostia oblata, in perpetuum sedere ad dextram Dei Patris, non vt seipsum rursus offerat, sed vt prorsus eos seruet, qui per ipsum accedunt ad Deum, perpetuum habens sacerdotium, & semper viuens vt interpellet pro eis, & vnici sacrificij semel in cruce peracti ac nunquam iterandi perpetua perfectaque efficacia eos plenissime Deo reconciliet,

page.notes: The last line "reconciliet," is set flush right. Greek words in the heading and first paragraph are reproduced as printed; the Greek in the margin note is printed in small type and reads "Apodeixis". The scan shows slight show-through and edge damage at the bottom left, not transcribed.
